description: `agro node` verbs for console sandbox nodes

userStories.title: Resolve the console URL and API key
userStories.description: As an operator, I want `agro` to find the console URL and API key so that each `agro node` verb can call the console API.
acceptanceCriteria: `SECRET_KEYS` in `.agro/cli/src/lib/secrets.ts` contains `AGRO_CONSOLE_URL` and `AGRO_CONSOLE_TOKEN`.
`COMPOSE_SECRET_KEYS` does not contain `AGRO_CONSOLE_URL` or `AGRO_CONSOLE_TOKEN`.
When the process environment sets a key, the resolver uses the environment value. Otherwise the resolver uses `readSecret` on the project root.
When either value is missing, each `agro node` verb exits 1 and prints `set AGRO_CONSOLE_URL and AGRO_CONSOLE_TOKEN, or run agro secret set <KEY>`.
The resolver never prints the token.
A test in `.agro/cli/src/__tests__/node.test.ts` covers the environment value, the `.env` fallback, and the missing-value error.
userStories.notes: executed: pnpm exec vitest run .agro/cli exit 0 (1346 tests, node.test.ts covers each criterion); npm --prefix .agro/cli run typecheck exit 0 on integrated task branch. Deviation accepted: command-table.ts gains node verbs.

userStories.title: Add `agro node create`
userStories.description: As an operator, I want `agro node create` to provision a sandbox node and wait for `running` so that I get an SSH command in one step.
acceptanceCriteria: `agro node create --spec <spec> --ssh-key <uuid> [--ssh-key <uuid>] [--name <name>]` sends `POST <AGRO_CONSOLE_URL>/api/nodes` with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and body `{"profile":"sandbox","spec":...,"sshKeyIds":[...]}`.
After HTTP 202, the verb polls `GET /api/nodes/<id>` until the status is `running` or a failure status, for at most 15 minutes.
When the node reaches `running`, the verb prints the node id, the status, and `ssh sandbox@<ipv4>`, then exits 0.
When the node reaches a failure status or the 15-minute limit passes, the verb prints the node id and the last status, then exits 1.
When the API returns a status of 400 or higher, the verb prints the HTTP status and the `code` field, then exits 1.
`--json` prints one JSON object with `id`, `status`, and `ssh`.
`.agro/cli/src/__tests__/node.test.ts` covers each criterion above against a stub `fetch`.
userStories.notes: executed: pnpm exec vitest run .agro/cli exit 0 (1346 tests, node.test.ts covers each criterion); npm --prefix .agro/cli run typecheck exit 0 on integrated task branch. Failure statuses repaired to console enum.

userStories.title: Add `agro node list` and `agro node delete`
userStories.description: As an operator, I want to list and delete console nodes from `agro` so that I can clean up sandbox nodes without the browser.
acceptanceCriteria: `agro node list [--json]` sends `GET /api/nodes` and prints one row per node: id, name, profile, status, and IPv4.
`agro node delete <id> [--yes]` asks for confirmation unless `--yes` is present, then sends `DELETE /api/nodes/<id>`.
When `DELETE` returns 403, the verb prints `destroy needs the admin role in agro-console` and exits 1.
`.agro/cli/src/__tests__/node.test.ts` covers list, delete, the confirmation, and the 403 message.
userStories.notes: executed: pnpm exec vitest run .agro/cli exit 0 (1346 tests, node.test.ts covers each criterion); npm --prefix .agro/cli run typecheck exit 0 on integrated task branch.

userStories.title: Document the `agro node` verbs
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the verb reference to list `agro node` so that I can find the verbs and the configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: `docs/lifecycle-commands.md` lists `agro node create`, `agro node list`, and `agro node delete` in the verb table.
`docs/lifecycle-commands.md` has a section that names `AGRO_CONSOLE_URL`, `AGRO_CONSOLE_TOKEN`, and the `agro secret set` fallback.
The section states that `agro node` manages remote console VMs, not local Docker sandboxes.
`agro --help` lists `agro node`.
The docs reference tests in `.agro/cli/src/__tests__/docs-reference.test.ts` exit 0.

userStories.title: Record manual review evidence
userStories.description: As the advisor, I want a transcript of each verb against a live console so that the PR proves the behavior end to end.
acceptanceCriteria: With operator approval, the agent runs `agro node create`, `agro node list`, and `agro node delete` against the dev console with an `mfc_` token.
The agent writes the transcript, with the token redacted, to `.agro/tasks/agro-node-verbs/evidence/manual-review.md`.
Over SSH on the node, `command -v agro code-server` prints nothing.
The agent destroys each node that the review created.
